races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Race

runners_data.name: Greek Mythology
runners_data.note: Unbeaten front runner returning after 126 days off but gets the tactical advantage of an uncontested lead in a small field.

runners_data.name: Controlled
runners_data.note: Prominent racer in excellent recent form with a good record on similar going, represents the main danger to the leader.

runners_data.name: Morehampton
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after 179 days absence with only modest form figures, needs significant improvement to feature.

runners_data.name: Neolithic
runners_data.note: Highest-rated runner who races prominently and showed improved form last time out, but inconsistent profile remains a concern.

races.paceDynamic: Greek Mythology will take this race by the scruff of the neck from the outset, setting a sustainable gallop with no other confirmed front runners to apply early pressure. Controlled, Morehampton and Neolithic will all settle prominently behind the leader, creating a compact group through the early stages. The lack of pace pressure means Greek Mythology can dictate terms and potentially kick clear when ready. This race shape strongly favours the leader and prominent racers, with no hold-up horses to benefit from a strong pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Greek Mythology Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Greek Mythology gets an easy lead and kicks clear turning for home.
scenarios.body: The leader can control the fractions completely and has the tactical advantage to put daylight between himself and the field. Controlled and Neolithic must chase from behind but face a tough task against a horse who can time his effort perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressures Leader
scenarios.trigger: If Controlled or Neolithic move up to challenge Greek Mythology early in the straight.
scenarios.body: The pace quickens significantly in the final two furlongs, creating a genuine speed duel that could see the leader crack. The most consistent prominent racer with the best recent form edge will prevail in a driving finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Prominent Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is pedestrian and one of the prominent runners produces a sustained late run.
scenarios.body: Morehampton or Neolithic times their challenge perfectly while Greek Mythology and others have gone too slow early. The horse with the best turn of foot from the prominent group capitalizes on tactical positioning.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Tactical Affair
scenarios.trigger: If Greek Mythology goes too slow early and the field bunches up turning for home.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish with all four horses having chances, but the lack of a strong pace means it comes down to raw ability rather than tactics. The highest-rated horse on pure class should emerge.

watchPoints.text: Greek Mythology's fitness after 126 days off could be exposed if Controlled or Neolithic apply serious pressure from the two-furlong pole.
Morehampton's lengthy absence of 179 days makes him vulnerable despite his prominent racing style suiting this race shape.
Controlled's recent second place over course and distance on soft ground makes him the most obvious threat to the leader.
Neolithic's RPR of 110 makes him the class horse on paper but his inconsistent form pattern suggests he's hard to trust.
The lack of hold-up horses means if the early pace is slow, this becomes a pure speed test in the final furlong.

races.paceDynamic: Unfamiliar is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate proceedings uncontested through early fractions, creating a sustainable tempo without pressure. Nephin Mountain may take prominent position but lacks the tactical speed to challenge for the lead. The methodical pace will suit hold-up horses who can conserve energy and deliver late kicks. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish fast on the soft ground, as Unfamiliar's lack of early pressure means plenty left in the tank for closers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Unfamiliar sets predictable fractions and the pace remains steady throughout
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader creates perfect stalking conditions for patient rides, allowing hold-up horses to time their challenges perfectly. Multiple closers will have chances to strike in the final furlong with the leader vulnerable late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Unfamiliar stays resolute
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runner maintains stamina reserves due to easy early sections
scenarios.body: Despite setting the pace, Unfamiliar's uncontested lead means energy conservation, potentially holding off late challengers who leave their runs too late. The soft ground aids the leader's stamina.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Nephin Mountain factors prominently
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runner applies more pressure than expected on Unfamiliar
scenarios.body: Early pressure forces a stronger pace, setting up the race for horses that can stay close enough to strike, though Nephin Mountain's fading tendency remains concerning. Mid-division horses benefit from the increased tempo.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If Unfamiliar crawls through sectionals with no pressure whatsoever
scenarios.body: An extremely slow pace turns the race into a pure sprint finish where tactical positioning matters more than stamina, potentially suiting any horse close enough to challenge. The race becomes a lottery in the final two furlongs.

watchPoints.text: Unfamiliar must be watched for any early pressure from Nephin Mountain that could compromise his stamina reserves

races.paceDynamic: Incredible Army will lead from the start with no genuine pace rival in this field of predominant hold-up horses. The lone prominent runner will dictate a comfortable gallop through the early stages, creating a pace setup that heavily favors front-runners and early prominent racers. With eight of nine runners adopting hold-up tactics, the backmarkers will have significant ground to make up in the straight. This race shape strongly favors horses that can track the leader early or those with proven tactical speed to get closer to the pace than their usual style suggests.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Incredible Army Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Incredible Army maintains a sustainable gallop and avoids early pressure
scenarios.body: The leader will have too much in hand turning for home with the hold-up brigade needing to produce exceptional finishing kicks on testing ground. McAteer can dictate terms throughout and kick clear when the backmarkers are still trying to close.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Fades Late
scenarios.trigger: If Incredible Army's finishing concerns manifest in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The leader will weaken inside the final 100 yards allowing the strongest closer to sweep past. Coincidental Glory's better class and Coen's 5lb claim become decisive factors.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Wins
scenarios.trigger: If one of the hold-up horses gets a more prominent position early
scenarios.body: A horse like Kactus Jack or Green Testimony tracks closer than usual and benefits from being within striking distance. The combination of pace advantage and finishing kick proves unbeatable.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Crawling Pace Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Incredible Army goes too slowly and bunches the field
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the home turn with pure finishing speed paramount. The longest-priced closer with residual ability gets first run on the leaders.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Incredible Army gets any early pressure from Areyousure as this could compromise the leader's stamina reserves

races.paceDynamic: Thrifty Of Digby will have an uncontested lead in this large field, with Independent Expert and Fast Tara the only other confirmed pace-pressing types likely to track within striking distance early. The soft ground and 1m trip will allow Thrifty Of Digby to dictate a steady rhythm without genuine pressure, creating a tactical race where positioning becomes crucial. With 12 hold-up horses in the field including Never Loose, Spanish Temptress and Angelight, the race will develop into a sprint finish where those coming from off the pace will have every chance to exploit the lack of early pressure. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce a sustained finish over the final 2f.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Thrifty Of Digby sets modest fractions and the pace collapses in the final 2f
scenarios.body: The large contingent of closers including Never Loose, Spanish Temptress and Angelight will have ideal conditions to unleash their finishing kicks. Soft ground stamina test rewards those saving energy early.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace collapse benefits mid-div
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuine enough to string out the field but not fast enough to stop closers
scenarios.body: Horses like Electric Beauty and Great Mover tracking in midfield can benefit from both a solid pace setup and avoid the traffic that deep closers face. Their prominent/midfield style bridges the gap perfectly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front group holds on
scenarios.trigger: If Thrifty Of Digby maintains kick and the soft ground blunts late challenges
scenarios.body: Independent Expert tracking the leader and any pace-pressers who settle well can exploit a slow finishing kick from the back markers. The 1m trip on soft ground may not provide enough time for hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete pace meltdown
scenarios.trigger: If no genuine pace materializes and it becomes a tactical crawl throughout
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint from the 3f pole where any horse with tactical speed can win regardless of typical running style. Jockey tactics and positioning matter more than form or style.

races.paceDynamic: Talk Show Host and Ethereal Star will force the early pace from the gates, with both confirmed front-runners likely to dispute the lead through the opening exchanges. However, both carry warnings about fading in the finish (Ethereal Star) or lack recent form (Talk Show Host), suggesting they may not sustain their efforts. The large field of 14 runners, predominantly hold-up horses, will create a bunched finish over the final two furlongs as the pace-setters tire. This tactical setup strongly favours hold-up horses and prominent runners who can finish strongly, as the early leaders are vulnerable to being swamped in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front-runners collapse early
scenarios.trigger: If Talk Show Host and Ethereal Star both fade before the final furlong
scenarios.body: The pace collapses dramatically, turning this into a sprint finish where the best finishers from off the pace can unleash their kicks. Hold-up horses with proven finishing ability like Matt Connor and Justenzia benefit most from the strong early gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Sustained honest gallop
scenarios.trigger: If Talk Show Host maintains his effort longer than expected while Ethereal Star fades
scenarios.body: A more even pace allows prominent runners to track the leader before challenging, while hold-up horses still get their favoured strong finish. The consistent tempo suits horses that can position handily and finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Messy tactical affair
scenarios.trigger: If both front-runners go too slow early, wary of each other
scenarios.body: The pace becomes stop-start with a frantic sprint finish, favouring horses with natural pace who can quicken fastest. Those drawn well with tactical speed benefit most from the scramble.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Wire-to-wire shock
scenarios.trigger: If Ethereal Star or Talk Show Host gets an uncontested lead and maintains it
scenarios.body: Despite their negative indicators, soft going and the 9½f distance could help one front-runner last home if allowed easy fractions. The weight advantage of Ethereal Star (119lbs) could prove decisive.

races.paceDynamic: Nancee Spain will take this field along as the only confirmed front runner, but her tendency to fade late creates a sustainable pace rather than a punishing gallop. The prominent brigade of Coeur Sublime, Zanahiyr, Light Up The Dark, Not Just Any Eagle and Plunkett Street will settle behind her without pressure, allowing the race to develop steadily through the middle stages. This sets up perfectly for the hold-up merchants Harry's Legacy, Slurricane, Rich Belief, Katherine and God Of Thunder to mount their challenges from the rear. The combination of Nancee Spain's fading pattern and the substantial 1m6f distance on testing soft ground heavily favours hold-up horses who can finish strongly.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Nancee Spain sets a modest pace and fades as expected.
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get the perfect setup to unleash their finishing kicks, with the testing conditions further favouring stamina over speed. Harry's Legacy and Slurricane benefit most from their trainer Ross O'Sullivan's excellent current form.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners apply early pressure to Nancee Spain.
scenarios.body: This creates a more genuine gallop that prevents the hold-up horses from closing effectively, allowing the better-rated prominent runners to maintain their advantage. Coeur Sublime's recent winning form and Zanahiyr's hat-trick streak make them prime beneficiaries.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Nancee Spain Surprises
scenarios.trigger: If Nancee Spain finds improved stamina at this longer trip.
scenarios.body: The 4-year-old gets an uncontested lead and kicks clear before the field can respond, defying her usual fading pattern. Her recent form suggests she's improving, and the longer distance might suit better than her usual 12f efforts.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent horses go too early chasing Nancee Spain.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a crawl until the final 3f, then explodes into a sprint finish that catches many off guard. The few horses held up closest to the pace gain the crucial positional advantage when the real running begins.

watchPoints.text: Nancee Spain sets too slow a pace early, allowing hold-up horses perfect conditions to pounce in the straight
Harry's Legacy and Slurricane both prominent in betting despite low ratings - Ross O'Sullivan stable confidence indicator
Coeur Sublime's fitness after 890-day absence, especially if travelling keenly in prominent position early
Sam Coen's handling of Zanahiyr's hat-trick bid under increased pressure as market support arrives
Light Up The Dark's position turning for home - needs to be handy given Joseph O'Brien's poor current form
